decisions.reason: A dedicated product page and its more differentiated analytics use case suggest it is strategic enough to retain while the firm tests market uptake further.
It has clear customer value and its own page, but tariff comparison is a competitive and potentially low-margin niche so some rationalisation risk remains.
The product is visibly marketed on its own page and fits a practical regional pricing tool portfolio, making continuation more likely than withdrawal.
Because it was only mentioned on the website and overlaps strongly with the more specific gas and electricity tariff tools, it is the most likely candidate for consolidation.
A standalone page indicates commitment, and as a supporting geo-definition tool it likely strengthens the broader location-based product suite.
It appears less established on the website and overlaps with the broader energy comparison offerings, so management would likely redeploy resources unless demand proves clearly distinct.
